mapper.select: SELECT id FROM requirement WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{reqId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT t.*, t.is_blocked AS blocked, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(tl.minutes), 0) FROM time_log tl WHERE tl.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND tl.task_id = t.id AND tl.ended_at IS NOT NULL FOR UPDATE) AS total_minutes FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.id = #{taskId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT t.*, t.is_blocked AS blocked, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(tl.minutes), 0) FROM time_log tl WHERE tl.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND tl.task_id = t.id AND tl.ended_at IS NOT NULL FOR UPDATE) AS total_minutes FROM task t INNER JOIN version_task vt ON vt.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND vt.task_id = t.id INNER JOIN project_version pv ON pv.workspace_id = vt.workspace_id AND pv.id = vt.version_id WHERE vt.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND vt.version_id = #{versionId} AND t.req_id = pv.req_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY t.id FOR UPDATE

SELECT DISTINCT t.*, t.is_blocked AS blocked, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(tl.minutes), 0) FROM time_log tl WHERE tl.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND tl.task_id = t.id AND tl.ended_at IS NOT NULL) AS total_minutes FROM task t INNER JOIN version_task vt ON vt.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND vt.task_id = t.id INNER JOIN project_version pv ON pv.workspace_id = vt.workspace_id AND pv.id = vt.version_id WHERE vt.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND vt.version_id IN #{versionId} AND t.req_id = pv.req_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY t.id

SELECT prv.version_id AS versionId, pv.name AS versionName, pv.req_id AS reqId, r.name AS projectName, pv.status AS versionStatus, pv.target_date AS targetDate, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM version_release vr WHERE vr.workspace_id = prv.workspace_id AND vr.version_id = prv.version_id AND vr.plan_id = prv.plan_id AND vr.result = 'success' AND vr.environment = 'production' AND vr.operation IN ('deploy','redeploy')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS released FROM version_release_plan_version prv INNER JOIN project_version pv ON pv.workspace_id = prv.workspace_id AND pv.id = prv.version_id INNER JOIN requirement r ON r.workspace_id = pv.workspace_id AND r.id = pv.req_id WHERE prv.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND prv.plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY r.name, COALESCE(pv.target_date, DATE(pv.released_at), DATE(pv.created_at)) DESC, pv.created_at DESC, pv.id DESC

SELECT r.id AS reqId, r.name AS projectName, v.id AS versionId, v.name AS versionName, v.status AS versionStatus, v.target_date AS targetDate FROM project_version v INNER JOIN requirement r ON r.workspace_id = v.workspace_id AND r.id = v.req_id WHERE v.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND r.archived_at IS NULL AND v.status NOT IN ('closed', 'canceled') ORDER BY r.name, COALESCE(v.target_date, DATE(v.released_at), DATE(v.created_at)) DESC, v.created_at DESC, v.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO version_release_plan_version (workspace_id, plan_id, version_id, req_id) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{planId}, #{versionId}, #{reqId})

SELECT vt.task_id AS taskId, vt.version_id AS versionId, pv.name AS versionName FROM version_task vt INNER JOIN task t ON t.workspace_id = vt.workspace_id AND t.id = vt.task_id INNER JOIN project_version pv ON pv.workspace_id = vt.workspace_id AND pv.id = vt.version_id AND pv.req_id = t.req_id WHERE vt.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND vt.task_id IN #{taskId} ORDER BY vt.task_id, vt.version_id FOR UPDATE

SELECT p.* FROM version_release_plan p WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM version_release_plan_version x WHERE x.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND x.plan_id = p.id AND x.version_id = #{versionId}) OR (p.version_id = #{versionId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM version_release_plan_version y WHERE y.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND y.plan_id = p.id))) ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO version_release_plan (id, workspace_id, version_id, plan_no, planned_at, owner_user_id, notes, risks, status, revision, scope_token, environment, target_keys, coverage) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{versionId}, #{planNo}, #{plannedAt}, #{ownerUserId}, #{notes}, #{risks}, #{status}, 0, #{scopeToken}, #{environment}, #{targetKeys,typeHandler=com.hourglass.mapper.ReleaseMapper$StringListTypeHandler}, #{coverage})
mapper.update: UPDATE version_release_plan SET version_id = #{versionId}, planned_at = #{plannedAt}, owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}, notes = #{notes}, risks = #{risks}, status = #{status}, scope_token = #{scopeToken}, environment = #{environment}, target_keys = #{targetKeys,typeHandler=com.hourglass.mapper.ReleaseMapper$StringListTypeHandler}, coverage = #{coverage}, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND revision = #{revision} AND status != 'completed'

UPDATE version_release_plan SET status = 'completed', revision = revision + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND revision = #{revision} AND status IN ('ready','draft','canceled')

SELECT vr.* FROM version_release vr INNER JOIN version_release_item i ON i.release_id = vr.id AND i.workspace_id = vr.workspace_id WHERE vr.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND i.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY vr.occurred_at DESC, vr.recorded_at DESC, vr.id DESC

SELECT vr.*, FROM version_release vr INNER JOIN version_release_item i ON i.release_id = vr.id AND i.workspace_id = vr.workspace_id WHERE vr.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM version_release_item d WHERE d.release_id = vr.id AND d.workspace_id = vr.workspace_id AND d.demand_id = #{demandId}) ORDER BY vr.occurred_at DESC, vr.recorded_at DESC, vr.id DESC, i.id

SELECT vr.*, FROM version_release vr INNER JOIN version_release_item i ON i.release_id = vr.id AND i.workspace_id = vr.workspace_id WHERE vr.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND vr.result = 'success' AND i.task_id IN #{taskId} ORDER BY vr.occurred_at, vr.recorded_at, vr.id, i.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO version_release (id, workspace_id, req_id, release_no, version_id, plan_id, plan_revision, result, published_on, recorded_at, released_by, released_by_name, version_name, project_name, notes, failure_reason, published_count, excluded_count, idempotency_key, request_hash, plan_snapshot, occurred_at, environment, target_keys, coverage, artifact_ref, artifact_digest, operation, related_release_id, executor_user_id, executor_name, deviation_reason) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{reqId}, #{releaseNo}, #{versionId}, #{planId}, #{planRevision}, #{result}, #{publishedOn}, #{recordedAt}, #{releasedBy}, #{releasedByName}, #{versionName}, #{projectName}, #{notes}, #{failureReason}, #{publishedCount}, #{excludedCount}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestHash}, #{planSnapshot}, #{occurredAt}, #{environment}, #{targetKeys,typeHandler=com.hourglass.mapper.ReleaseMapper$StringListTypeHandler}, #{coverage}, #{artifactRef}, #{artifactDigest}, #{operation}, #{relatedReleaseId}, #{executorUserId}, #{executorName}, #{deviationReason})
